# has data controller

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasDataController`](gmeow-hasDataController.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasDataController>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

The data controller responsible for processing personal data under a rights statement — the agent that determines the purposes and means of processing.
